Package org.cha0scollective.wwpg.api

package org.cha0scollective.wwpg.api
Stationary electrical extension API 1.0.

All quantities use SI units. Element voltage is positive-node voltage minus negative-node voltage; positive current flows from the positive node to the negative node. Positive power is absorbed by the element. A supplying source therefore normally has negative current and power. Native terminal numbers are explicit persistent IDs, never positions in a list.

WWPG invokes preparation and gameplay commit once per server game tick. Descriptions capture immutable inputs. Queries and preparation do not advance stored energy. Only accepted electrical substeps advance solver history; nonlinear trial iterations do not. The owning add-on persists committed state received in results and supplies it when an element is reconstructed.
